_provenance.note: Measured BEFORE PC.1 fixed the applicability sample (2/14 -> 13/14 documents detecting a schema), before N.5a carried the pass counters through the merge, and before N.5d closed the seam that lets those counters reach a run summary at all. So the entity counts here come from runs that mostly took the legacy single-schema path, and over_generation_rate / abstain_rate are null because nothing was carrying them - not because nothing was culled. The gate reports those two as SKIPPED rather than passing them. Three cautions for whoever re-measures: (1) the eight source records cover seven distinct PDFs (Achterhoek was run twice and its 0-entity record was dropped from the list while its zero stayed in the totals), so this is not reproducible by one harness run; (2) abstain_rate's denominator is chunk-PASSES, so a multi-schema re-measure is structurally higher than a single-schema one and may fail the ceiling without a regression; (3) a re-measure that takes the LEGACY path yields null for both rates rather than a number - that path drives a pluggable extractor rather than run_pass2 and cannot count abstention, and summarise_run now requires each rate's own inputs from every document rather than inferring one from another's presence.
